summary: Checks whether pyOCD is available, preferring the bundled copy of the active Visual Studio Code CMSIS Debugger extension and otherwise a runnable pyocd in the active shell, and returns one availability record without installing or modifying anything.
triggers: before a workflow needs to run pyOCD
without installing, configuring, or modifying it
verification: Confirm the result in the environment used for the lookup
a bundled result requires the exact extension ID and its `tools/pyocd/` directory
a PATH result requires a successful `pyocd --version`
Use `pyocd --version` as the repeatable runnable-command check.
In Visual Studio Code, use the exact installed-extension identifier `arm.vscode-cmsis-debugger` and verify its actual `tools/pyocd/` subdirectory.
stop_conditions: When verified, report this bundled directory as the preferred pyOCD installation and stop: it is not necessary to check `PATH`.
Do not proceed to target detection or install software.
Report the relevant check as unavailable when the required terminal, extension query, or extension directory cannot be accessed. Do not search unrelated directories or request a target connection.

rules.delta: executable path, extension location, version, or availability from the extension identifier alone
pyOCD or an extension, change `PATH`, activate an environment, or alter Visual Studio Code settings
